system.description:
A set of [[/r 1d4+2]] rough-hewn wooden nesting dolls. Separating a doll, placing it on the ground, and speaking the command word grows it into an obedient construct until destroyed. Roll [[/r 1d6]] for each doll's size and stats:

  • 1: 3' tall — 1 HD (5 HP), AC 7 (AAC 12), #AT 2 (1d4/1d4).
  • 2: 4' tall — 2 HD (10 HP), AC 6 (AAC 13), #AT 2 (1d4+1/1d4+1).
  • 3: 5' tall — 3 HD (15 HP), AC 5 (AAC 14), #AT 2 (1d6/1d6).
  • 4: 6' tall — 4 HD (20 HP), AC 4 (AAC 15), #AT 2 (1d8/1d8).
  • 5: 7' tall — 5 HD (25 HP), AC 3 (AAC 16), #AT 2 (1d10/1d10).
  • 6: 8' tall — 6 HD (30 HP), AC 2 (AAC 17), #AT 2 (2d6/2d6).
